result.result: TOOL_LIMITATION: The Figma prototype canvas renders the app interface (including the "进入工作区 →" button on the first card "本校推免资格核对") as a vector canvas (SVG/IMG layer). The clickable prototype hotspots are embedded in the canvas rendering and do not have individual DOM element IDs. Multiple clicks on the viewerContainer (generic background clicks) were attempted, but none triggered a frame transition. The Figma prototype viewer's hotspot overlay is not accessible as discrete DOM elements, preventing precise mouse clicks at the visually observed app hotspots as required by the task instructions. No frame navigation, URL change, or content transition occurred after repeated clicks on the canvas area. The task requires: "use a real mouse click at the visually observed app hotspot, NOT just DOM click on accessibility text and NOT generic viewerContainer" and "Do not substitute fullscreen, generic background clicks or frame stepping for any step." Since the precise hotspot cannot be identified in the DOM, the mandatory "进入工作区 →" button test could not be performed. Next steps that were dependent on this transition (clicking 来源与条件, ranking card/补充排名信息, inspecting missing-data state, using preset example) also could not be executed.
